examples: AQMA designation is a planning/environmental constraint layer, not proof a parcel is unbuildable
Environmental permit application is not an issued permit or planning permission
Closed consultation does not prove permit grant/refusal without decision evidence
Historic Barking Power Station permit is installation-specific and must not be projected to nearby parcels
Withdrawn B&D Energy application must not be promoted as an active permit
Odour/risk-management documents are evidence inputs, not proof of no impact
TE2100 flood adaptation context is strategic and defence-dependent
Climate/air-quality policy goals do not create a parcel growth score without current site evidence
